additional_info.subject: RE: ID0431620-/Si-D/NZ-[Y2 / R3 313057296006] Low Power Supply CRM:02888000084
additional_info.body:
Hi Liz Hatton,
Thank you for sharing the OCPP logs. I’ve reviewed them, and as per the data, the charger is indeed delivering a current of 35A. Unfortunately, we are not receiving logs on our backend, which limits our ability to investigate the issue thoroughly. We are currently coordinating with our regional team to enable log transmission from the charger to our backend system. Kindly allow us some time—once we start receiving the logs, we’ll be able to analyze how the charger is delivering power.
Additionally, we’ve observed that the input power for this unit is currently limited to 139 kVA, whereas the charger’s capacity is 160 kW. The recommended input power for optimal performance is 170 kVA. Could you please confirm whether it’s possible to adjust the input power settings accordingly?
Looking forward to your response.
Best Regards,
Sominath Nagalgaon
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
